title: The Waters Recede
art: The shape of the mountains is imagined; the Quran names the resting place al-Judi.
imagePrompt: Total stillness after the storm: a soft pale morning sky over a vast flat sea that reflects it like a mirror, a small wooden ship floating alone; then the water slowly sinks away, mountain tops appearing above the surface, then ridges, then valleys, until the ship comes to rest gently on a high mountain; a wide view of the ship on the summit framed by clouds clearing in layered ink-wash strokes, a single bird flying out from it across the sky; soft pale blue, silver and white turning to warm green returning to the land, parchment texture.

beats.say: Then the storm was gone, and the sea lay still as a mirror.

verse.en: And it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold [your rain]." And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and the ship came to rest on the [mountain of] Judiyy…

beats.say: A single bird flew out from the ship across the clearing sky.
